session.note: Web Console idle policy for each launched supervisor session: once its Codex has written nothing for this long, with no goal active and no turn or sub-agent running, Web Console archives the session (freeing its memory) and records why; Reopen brings back the thread and its goal. 6h because a finished 24h lead was measured holding 2.4-2.6 GB idle for 15-21 h, and leads with a blocked goal sat 6-10 h at 0.6 GB (2026-11-21). A Go duration from 15m to 168h.

read_sets.note: What each role reads. The desk flags a read set over any ceiling here (mission_bytes included) in the preflight and the steward packets the trim; it never refuses a launch for read cost (R1). gates.charter_bytes only warns (a build goes ahead); stance_chars and kernel_chars are hard gates because Codex drops a goal over about 700 characters. skill_bytes keep headroom over the measured sizes; mission_bytes was cut from 40,000 to 20,000 on 2026-11-20.
read_sets.owner_topic_note: Each owner also reads its topic's MISSION.md, held to ceilings.mission_bytes; it is not summed into owner_start_bytes, which bounds skill text only.

evidence.models: The Codex models and efforts the research skills allow, from ~/.codex/models_cache.json on 2026-11-11 (gpt-6-luna supports low to max; astra and sol up to ultra). A spec value outside these lists is invalid_spec. Adding a model is an edit here.
